pages.title: Fruit Rush
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Fruit Rush is a pattern-matching challenge built around reacting quickly to fruit arrangements. Reproduce the required patterns to keep a streak going and increase your score. Use the special boosters at the bottom when you need help clearing more fruit.

pages.title: CodeQuest
pages.creator: SyntaxForge
pages.description: CodeQuest turns Python programming into a cyberpunk adventure. Type code in the editor and run it to help the hero defeat enemies across ten missions. Use hints when you need guidance or reset the starter code to try another solution.

pages.title: Closed City
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Closed City is a shooting sandbox set in a city threatened by a zombie infection. Explore the quarantined area, collect weapons and ammunition, and fight to survive. Optional missions give you objectives when you want a more directed challenge.

pages.title: Just Mahjong
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Just Mahjong follows the tile-pairing rules of mahjong solitaire. Remove identical tiles that are uncovered and free on at least one side. Choose pairs that open useful parts of the layout as you work toward clearing the board.

pages.title: Egg Adventure: Mirror World
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Egg Adventure: Mirror World sends Mr. Egg through familiar-looking rooms with changed solutions. Manipulate the characters and surroundings to work out each puzzle. Find the method that opens a way to the door and advances the adventure.

pages.title: Tower Guardian - Epic Defense
pages.creator: Gameyogi
pages.description: Tower Guardian - Epic Defense puts you in charge of protecting a tower from approaching monsters. Rotate to aim, summon warriors, and use abilities against the waves. Upgrade heroes and unlock further levels as the attacks become stronger.

pages.title: Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory lets you grow a chocolate-making business. Produce bars, upgrade machinery, and expand the production lines to increase output. Use the earnings to develop the factory and keep more of the candy operation running.

pages.title: Arcade Rope
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Arcade Rope makes a rope your tool for demolishing buildings. Move around structures to wrap them, then pull the rope tight enough to bring them down. Collect and sell the debris, and upgrade your equipment for the next group of buildings.

pages.title: Drawing Squares
pages.creator: Rabbit Bay Games
pages.description: Drawing Squares is a digital version of Dots and Boxes. Add lines between dots and try to complete more squares than your opponent. Think about what each placement leaves behind so the next player cannot easily claim a box.

pages.title: FaceChart
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: FaceChart gives you a face chart as a canvas for makeup experiments. Choose skin tones and colors, then combine them into a planned look. Try different arrangements to create anything from a restrained style to a more elaborate design.

pages.title: Solve the Cube Wooden Blocks 2D!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Solve the Cube Wooden Blocks 2D! asks you to place wooden blocks into a playing area and fill complete lines. Finished lines disappear and award points, making room for more shapes. Leave useful spaces so later blocks still have somewhere to fit.

pages.title: Idle Restaurant Tycoon
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Idle Restaurant Tycoon puts you in charge of staffing and developing a restaurant. Hire a chef, improve the team, and manage the money needed for further growth. Check the market for gifts while building up the food business.

pages.title: Mahjong At Home - Scandinavian Edition
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Mahjong At Home - Scandinavian Edition offers tile-matching boards with Nordic winter styling. Find identical tiles that can be removed and gradually uncover the layout beneath. Keep pairing the available pieces until the board is clear.

pages.title: Super Elip Adventure
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Super Elip Adventure follows an ellipse through hazardous maps in search of stars. Navigate around obstacles and enemies while gathering the stars needed to unlock the house. Complete the current area's objective to move on to the next challenge.

pages.title: New Year Balls Merge
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: New Year Balls Merge is a dropping puzzle with festive colored balls. Bring matching balls together to create larger ones and earn points. Plan where new pieces will land as the playing area becomes increasingly crowded.

pages.title: Drunken Fighters Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drunken Fighters Online puts unsteady stickman fighters into hand-to-hand battles. Move around the ring, throw punches, and fall back when an opponent presses the attack. Balance aggressive hits with protecting your fighter's remaining health.

pages.title: Long Hand Escape
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Long Hand Escape is a puzzle about extending a flexible arm to reach treasure. Slide to guide the long hand through the scene and work out a safe route. Use the unusual reach to solve the obstacles around the prize.

pages.title: Hot Pot Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hot Pot Rush makes food preparation part of a running course. Gather hot pots and ingredients such as vegetables or chicken while avoiding obstacles. Build up the dishes along the route so there is more food to serve to customers.

pages.title: Stickman Triple Kill
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Triple Kill sends a stickman through fights with enemies, traps, and bosses. Aim your attacks with mouse or touch input and position the character to avoid danger. Work through the levels while trying different characters and weapons.

pages.title: Endless Bubbles
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Endless Bubbles is a bubble shooter about clearing matching colors. Swipe to aim and tap to fire into the field. Form groups of at least three bubbles to burst them and keep opening space for more shots.

pages.title: Ice Cream Clicker
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Ice Cream Clicker lets you develop an ice cream business through repeated taps. Click the ice cream to earn progress, purchase upgrades, and unlock automatic clicking. Keep building the operation to discover the collection of twenty-seven ice creams.

pages.title: Speedy Paws
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Speedy Paws challenges you to reach the finish while passing traps and obstacles. Move around the route and jump when needed, collecting crystals for new skins. Coins can buy a shield or an extra life for another attempt.

pages.title: Slice it All
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Slice It All sends a flipping knife along a course of objects to cut. Tap at the right time to turn the blade and slice what lies ahead. Keep it moving safely until it reaches the scoreboard at the end.

pages.title: Merge To Explode
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Merge To Explode makes rocket merging the key to demolishing buildings. Drag a rocket onto another compatible one to create a stronger weapon. Keep combining the available rockets to increase the damage dealt to the structure.

pages.title: Rope The City
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Rope The City asks you to move around buildings and wrap them with a rope. Encircle the structures and use the rope to bring them under control. Spend collected money improving the equipment so you can handle more of the city.

pages.title: Sandwich Shuffle
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Sandwich Shuffle challenges you to guide sandwich ingredients along a moving course. Swipe left and right to position the food, pick up useful additions, and avoid obstacles. Deliver the assembled sandwiches to customers at the end.

pages.title: Word Swipe
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Word Swipe is a timed word-finding puzzle. Swipe through at least three letters to form a word, with longer words earning more points. Keep finding valid combinations before the level's countdown ends to continue your progress.

pages.title: 2048 Run 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: 2048 Run 3D combines an obstacle course with numbered-ball merging. Guide your ball into ones with the same color and value to increase its number. Avoid the road hazards while trying to reach 2048 and improve the final score.

pages.title: 8Bit Black Ropeman
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: 8Bit Black Ropeman challenges you to jump between walls without touching dangerous wheels. Aim the next leap with the directional arrow and release to launch. Work through the route until you reach the flag marking the end.

pages.title: The Smurfs Village Cleaning
pages.creator: IMPS
pages.description: The Smurfs Village Cleaning follows a gift explosion that leaves the village covered in soot. Help clean the Smurfs' houses and belongings using the available tools. Click or drag over the dirty areas to restore the village's appearance.

pages.title: Boxman Sokoban
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Boxman Sokoban is a box-pushing puzzle about placing every crate on a marked square. Move around the grid and push boxes one at a time, planning around narrow spaces. Undo a mistake or restart when a crate blocks the route.

pages.title: Drunken Boxing: Ultimate
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drunken Boxing: Ultimate brings unsteady boxers into a physics-based fight. Keep your balance while moving toward the opponent and throwing punches. When the special-hit meter fills, choose the right moment to use the fighter's unusual ranged attack.

pages.title: Crazy Intersection
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Crazy Intersection challenges you to release cars into crossing traffic without causing a crash. Watch the moving vehicles and tap when a safe gap appears. Successful crossings add to your progress, while poor timing creates trouble at the junction.

pages.title: Zombie Last Castle 4
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Last Castle 4 makes you defend a castle from zombies approaching on both sides. Use stronger weapons and bonuses to hold back the waves. Up to four players can join the defense, dividing attention between the two fronts.

pages.title: Green and Blue Cuteman 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Green and Blue Cuteman 2 follows two alien friends through obstacle-filled levels. Control the green and blue characters and use double jumps where extra height is needed. Keep both travelers moving safely toward the final stage.

pages.title: Fishy trick
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Fishy Trick follows a fish through dangerous ocean routes while rescuing companions. Control its swimming height, avoid sharks and other threats, and collect stars. Use the stars for skins and keep the growing group alive along the journey.

pages.title: Stickman Ghost Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Stickman Ghost Online is an action game about fighting through a city of hostile stickmen. Combine movement, jumps, and weapon attacks to defeat groups and reach bosses. Collect coins to improve the character's equipment and combat options.

pages.title: Trains.io 3D
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Trains.io 3D turns a slithering arena game into a contest between growing trains. Gather screws and toolboxes, consume other trains, and build a longer vehicle. Use the boost when a burst of speed helps you navigate the crowded world.

pages.title: Kris Mahjong Animals
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Kris Mahjong Animals asks you to remove pairs of identical animal tiles. The connecting route must be clear and use no more than two corners. Open paths through the grid and keep matching before the timer reaches zero.

pages.title: Love Pin Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Love Pin Online presents rescue puzzles involving a girlfriend held captive by a criminal. Study each scene and choose the moves that lead to a safe rescue. A poor decision can turn the attempt into a disaster, but the level can be retried.

pages.title: Making Homemade Veg Burger
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Making Homemade Veg Burger lets you help Emma prepare a vegetable burger for dinner. Work through the cooking activity to assemble the homemade meal, then choose an outfit for her. Complete both preparations before she enjoys the food.

pages.title: Fun Halloween Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Fun Halloween Jigsaw offers twelve seasonal pictures that unlock in sequence. Choose a puzzle with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces, then place the sections correctly. Complete the image to move on to another Halloween scene.

pages.title: Just Draw
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Just Draw is a picture puzzle in which one part of an object is missing. Inspect the illustration and draw the absent section with a sliding gesture. Use familiar object shapes to work out what belongs in the gap.

pages.title: 2048 Drop
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: 2048 Drop asks you to position falling numbered tiles and merge equal values. Slide a tile left or right, then drop it onto a useful spot. Keep combining numbers to create space before the board fills up.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Futuristic
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Objects Futuristic sends you into cluttered scenes from the future. Find the objects listed beside the picture before the timer expires. Zoom in on small details or use a hint when an item proves difficult to locate.

pages.title: HidJigs Hello Summer
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: HidJigs Hello Summer offers hidden-object searches and jigsaw puzzles with summer scenery. Search pictures for the listed items or rebuild them from pieces. Use zoom and hints when needed while working through the sixteen illustrated challenges.

pages.title: Mexican Skeleton Party Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Mexican Skeleton Party Difference asks you to compare two party pictures and find their differences. Select the seven changed details before the timer runs out. Search carefully through the skeleton-themed scenes and avoid marking places that are identical.

pages.title: Viking Warrior Battle Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Viking Warrior Battle Jigsaw offers twelve Viking battle pictures to rebuild. Choose twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces and drag them into place. Match edges and details until the complete scene is restored at your chosen difficulty.

pages.title: Alfajores
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Alfajores guides you through making the cookie dessert with Hazel and her mother. Follow the cooking instructions and work through the preparation steps in order. Assemble the ingredients into a finished batch as part of the kitchen lesson.

pages.title: Military Soldiers In Battle Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Military Soldiers In Battle Jigsaw turns twelve military scenes into jigsaw challenges. Pick an image and one of three piece counts, then arrange its sections correctly. Work from a simple twenty-five-piece board up to a one-hundred-piece puzzle.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Tracks Drive
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Impossible Truck Tracks Drive puts large trucks on narrow tracks high above the ground. Steer carefully through the elevated route and keep the vehicle away from the edges. Judge turns and changes in the road before committing the heavy truck.

pages.title: Kids Learning Farm Animals Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Kids Learning Farm Animals Memory combines animal recognition with a memory activity. Select animal pictures to hear their names, then test your recall in the matching game. Remember the cards' positions to find their partners more efficiently.

pages.title: Dunk Fall
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Dunk Fall is a basketball scoring challenge about sending the ball cleanly through hoops. Judge the ball's position and time your action to line up the basket. Keep improving your accuracy to build a higher score.

pages.title: Shove them
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shove Them puts you on a building with a crowd to push away. Move into position and open the extending tool to shove people off the platform. Rotate and line up a useful push while keeping control of your character.

pages.title: The Cave of Terror
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: The Cave of Terror sends you through a dangerous cave with enemies and obstacles. Collect coins and ammunition, use rocket boosts to reach higher supplies, and fire at the creatures. Keep avoiding hazards to extend the run and increase your score.

pages.title: Stickman Jumping
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Stickman Jumping follows a stickman through an obstacle-filled escape route. Use mouse input to time jumps and movement along the ropes. Get past the next danger and keep the character moving through the adventure.

pages.title: Goldblade and the dangerous water
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Goldblade and the Dangerous Water follows Goldblade's fight to free a kingdom from water monsters. Guide the hero through the route and confront the creatures ahead. Use keyboard controls on desktop or the on-screen buttons on mobile to continue the adventure.

pages.title: VSCO Girl Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: VSCO Girl Fashion lets you advise Anna, Lisa, and Milla on new everyday outfits. Browse the clothing options and combine pieces that fit the VSCO theme. Style all three friends with their own updated looks.

pages.title: Save Mushrooms Garden
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Save Mushrooms Garden follows Johnny across villages in pursuit of people who stole his mushrooms. Move through the areas, jump past obstacles, and fire at enemies. Help him recover the mushrooms while fighting his way through the opposition.

pages.title: Mini Toy Car Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Mini Toy Car Racing Game puts remote-control-style cars on driving tracks. Steer, accelerate, and brake to handle the small vehicles in free driving or the elevated-track mode. Explore the courses and practice keeping the toy car under control.

pages.title: T Rex N.Y Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: T Rex N.Y Online gives you a robotic T-Rex for a destructive rampage through New York. Move along the streets and use its attacks to damage everything in the way. Try to cause as much destruction as possible during the run.

pages.title: Lovely Christmas Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Lovely Christmas Slide offers three festive pictures as sliding-tile puzzles. Choose an image and one of three modes, then move the scrambled sections toward their correct positions. Reassemble the picture by planning around the available space.

pages.title: Mahjong Pretty Manga Girls
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Mahjong Pretty Manga Girls asks you to remove pairs of identical mahjong tiles. Find the available matches and clear the board to finish a level. Progress through increasingly difficult arrangements to unlock more illustrated characters.

pages.title: Bottle Pop!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Bottle Pop! is an arcade challenge in which taps make a bottle jump, fly, or burst into motion. Control its travel through levels containing obstacles such as lasers, fans, and spikes. Adjust the timing to handle the next arrangement safely.

pages.title: Movie Night Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Movie Night Match 3 uses cinema-themed items in a matching puzzle. Arrange at least three identical pieces together to clear them and increase your score. Keep making matches so the meter on the left does not fall too low.

pages.title: Monster Jump
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Monster Jump lets you charge a leap by holding, then release to launch the monster. Avoid rockets, collect candies for power-ups, and gather mini-monsters that can revive it. Judge the power of each jump to travel farther.

pages.title: Thief Fps Fire Marshal
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Thief FPS Fire Marshal is a first-person shooter with missions against hostile forces. Move through the area, aim down the weapon's sights, and fire at enemies. Reload, crouch, or use time dilation when the combat situation calls for another approach.

pages.title: Scatty Maps Africa
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Scatty Maps Africa is a geography puzzle about placing countries on a map. Drag each country shape to its correct location and build up the continent. Choose the easier option or the full map for a more extensive challenge.

pages.title: Cute Birds Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cute Birds Memory hides matching bird pictures behind cards. Turn over a pair and remember any positions that do not match. Choose a mode and keep finding identical pictures until the level has been cleared.

pages.title: Nissan Titan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Nissan Titan Puzzle offers six pictures of the truck as jigsaw puzzles. Select a sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one-hundred-piece version, then place the parts correctly. Rebuild the vehicle and its surroundings to complete the image.

pages.title: Orange Hero Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Orange Hero Jigsaw gives you twelve pictures to assemble at three difficulty settings. Choose a twenty-five, forty-nine, or one-hundred-piece puzzle and fit its sections together. Use matching colors and edges to restore the full hero-themed picture.

pages.title: Scatty Maps Asia
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Scatty Maps Asia asks you to build a map by placing countries in their correct locations. Drag the shapes onto the continent and check their fit. Two modes provide a simpler activity or a fuller test of your geography knowledge.

pages.title: City Car Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: City Car Stunt sends cars onto elevated roads between skyscrapers. Complete six challenging courses with ramps, obstacles, and sections that test your control. Play alone or with a second driver, or experiment in the free-driving mode.

pages.title: Fun Head Soccer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fun Head Soccer is a football duel played with oversized-headed characters. Move left or right, jump to meet the ball, and send it toward the opposing goal. Defend your own end while looking for an opening to score.

pages.title: Emerald Crush
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Emerald Crush is a gem-matching puzzle in which you exchange pieces to form matches of three. Select two gems to move them and look for useful combinations. Keep clearing the changing board to continue the challenge.

pages.title: Marble Blast
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Marble Blast is a colored-marble shooter with groups to clear from the field. Aim the cannon and send a marble toward a useful matching cluster. Use the available shots and special items to work through the level's targets.

pages.title: Sure Shot
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Sure Shot is an online first-person shooter with five game modes and two combat locations. Move around the battlefield, choose among four weapon types, and fight other players. Reload, take cover, and gather supplies as the match develops.

pages.title: Knife Smash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Knife Smash challenges you to throw knives into rotating targets. Tap when an opening is clear, avoiding the blades and obstacles already attached. Complete the levels with accurate throws and collect more unusual knives along the way.

pages.title: Free Rally
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Free Rally gives multiplayer drivers a large training ground and eight vehicles to explore. Drive around the area, take ramps, and experiment with jumps alongside other players. Change the camera view or vehicle lighting while trying different driving styles.

pages.title: Nova Billiard
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Nova Billiard lets you line up cue shots and send balls toward the table's pockets. Play solo, practice in training, or compete in multiplayer. Switch between two-dimensional and three-dimensional camera views to inspect the next shot.

pages.title: Helix Fall
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Helix Fall challenges you to smash through platforms on the way to the bottom of a tower. Break the safe sections while avoiding deadly obstacles along the descent. Collect coins during the run and use them to unlock skins.

pages.title: Dino Squad Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dino Squad Adventure pairs two dinosaurs with different abilities for shared missions. One can pass through walls, while the other uses weapons against enemies. Coordinate their movement, collect gold, and use each dinosaur's strengths to finish the route.

pages.title: Space Rescue
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Space Rescue makes you draw the flight path for a rescue spaceship. Drag the blue orb to plan a route that collects every astronaut before the endpoint. Keep the ship away from UFOs and asteroids along the way.

pages.title: Jewel Legend
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Jewel Legend asks you to swap jewels and complete a series of clearing objectives. Look for useful matching arrangements and remove the required pieces. A magic crystal ball provides an extra way to help clear jewels from the board.

pages.title: Neon Road
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Neon Road is a physics platform game with glowing courses to navigate. Guide the character through jumps and obstacles toward the level's finish, collecting stars along the route. Work through the different road layouts without falling into danger.

pages.title: Unmatch
pages.creator: Supernapie
pages.description: Unmatch is a tile puzzle about making groups of three with matching or deliberately different features. Consider shape, color, and the number of symbols when choosing a combination. Complete the tutorials, then try creating your own levels in the editor.

pages.title: Baby Doll Creator
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Baby Doll Creator lets you design a doll using a wardrobe and appearance options. Choose hair, skin tone, eye details, and clothing to shape the character. Mix the available pieces until the finished doll has the look you want.

pages.title: Airplains Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Airplains Hidden Stars challenges you to locate five stars in each cartoon airplane picture. Inspect the scene closely and select the concealed shapes. Find all five to finish the current image and move on to the next search.

pages.title: Shoot Up!
pages.creator: Plonga.com
pages.description: Shoot Up! puts a movable cannon against numbered blocks. Slide into position and fire streams of balls to break as many blocks as possible. Buy upgrades to increase the cannon's power and firing speed for later attempts.

pages.title: Bazooka and Monster 2 Halloween
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bazooka and Monster 2 Halloween is a shooting puzzle about eliminating monsters with a bazooka. Aim carefully and use ricochets off suitable objects to reach awkward targets. Find a shot path that avoids obstacles and clears the Halloween creatures.

pages.title: Doomsday Defender
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Doomsday Defender turns a threatened nuclear control panel into an arrow-matching puzzle. Rotate the arrows until they all point in the same direction, then correct new changes quickly. Keeping them aligned restores the control bar and builds your score.
